comments: One drawing 1467x995, BOX reduced to 188x128 (anchor bottom-centre); no stretch. The stone is not dimmed here (the lane suggests about 20 percent in the stage).

Imported, left off: the stage has no hook for it (the rules' arch is a canyon-wide wall with a 4.8 by 3.0 unit rectangular opening; the painting's opening is 78 by 92 dots with a round top and no wall, so a fit needs a 1.6 to 1 stretch the importer does not do). See assets/griffinwing/ART.md.
geometry: A rock arch whose clear opening is where the sim puts it: the rules own the opening (half width, half height) and judge every scrape; art never sets a hitbox (none).
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered drawing, 2026-10-19: a ruined stone arch, two piers, a voussoir ring with the upper left broken, tumbled blocks, four chained lanterns, the opening clear alpha.
timing: idle 1 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/griffinwing/slots.json.
